readme_summary: A modern distributed network for the Smart Economy. Documentation » · developers.neo.org Neo · Neo Modules · Neo DevPack               It is **not** the program that starts a node. Neo-CLI lives in neo-project/neo-node. The virtual machine lives in neo-project/neo-vm. Official N3 developer hub: developers.neo.org. (The older docs.neo.org tutorials still exist; prefer developers.neo.org for current N3 APIs.) Beginner-friendly guides in this repository (covers **neo**, **neo-node**, and **neo-vm**): * neo: The core libraries for NEO. Guide: docs/neo-core.md. * neo-node: Neo-CLI and plugins (DBFT, RpcServer, Oracle, ApplicationLogs, storage engines, etc.). Guide: docs/neo-node.md. How to run: docs/how-to/run-a-node.md. * neo-vm: The Neo Virtual Machine. Guide: docs/neo-vm.md. * neo-express: A private net optimized for development scenarios. * neo-devpack-d
